title: Claude Code plugin masks secrets and customer data, then restores them when Claude writes
summary: A developer built a Claude Code plugin that masks secrets and personal data before Claude sees them; he reports tasks still get done while real values stay local.
agent_role: Claude Code carries out normal tasks such as reading logs and drafting replies on masked data. The plugin handles masking and restore. The human labels false alarms and approves unmasking rules.
outcome: Author reports Claude can still complete tasks using placeholders while real values never reach the model. A local model leads to some false alarms.
what_they_did: A developer wrote a Claude Code plugin that sits on the hooks that run before and after each tool call. File reads, command output and OCR'd scans are scanned for secrets, checksum numbers and personal data, and each value becomes a consistent placeholder. When Claude writes a file or runs a command, the real values are restored from an encrypted local vault. A local dashboard lets the user label false alarms and turn them into rules.
how_it_went: The author shows a support note and a database URL reaching Claude fully masked, while drafts on disk contain the real names. They say making restore-on-write reliable was harder than detection.
worth_knowing: It fails closed: if the checker is down, tool calls are held back. The author says it stops accidental exposure but is not a sandbox against a model deliberately leaking data.
prompt: Install the Cloakroom plugin in Claude Code (/plugin marketplace add shanjeevrajendran/cloakroom, then /plugin install cloakroom@cloakroom). Then help me fix [failing job or task] in [project folder], which contains .env files and [support exports or logs]. Work only with the masked placeholders you are given. Before writing any file or running any command that would send data outside my machine, show me your plan and wait for my approval.

curation.rationale: A concrete, open-source Claude Code plugin with clear before/after examples of what the agent sees. It is detailed and useful, though it is mainly a tool write-up rather than a measured outcome.
